title: Independent implementation provenance
summary: Capture a VIB-specific research-to-requirements policy: lawful source inspection, private provenance, original design and tests, no unapproved reuse, required legal notices preserved. Owner-approved direction is separate from package integration.

origin.source: Owner-directed VIB engineering research and independent implementation discussion, 2026-11-25; source-level provenance retained separately.

benefits: Maintains product identity and traceable development
risks: Private source records must not leak; provenance is not legal clearance or formal clean-room proof

evidence.claim: Existing VIB candidate context only; does not establish implementation or acceptance of this idea.
